Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data swap error in the "Updated Understanding" section of Step 10. After correctly identifying that Georges Méliès was born in 1861 and James Tinling was born in 1889 (per Wikipedia), the Planner incorrectly reversed these values in the summary, stating "Christ Walking on the Water -- Director: Georges M li s -- Birth year: 1898" and "45 Fathers -- Director: James Tinling -- Birth year: 1861." This hallucination of swapped birth years led to the incorrect final conclusion that Méliès was born later.
